## Selected projects

### AquaTrack

Enterprise water consumption and billing management system for apartment communities.

- Repository: https://github.com/mdmoin7/aquatrack
- Technologies: React, TypeScript, Vite, Firebase, Firestore
- Capabilities: consumption tracking, billing, alerts, role-based access, offline persistence, analytics and Firebase security rules
- Architecture: a data-store abstraction supports demo/local storage and Firebase/Firestore cloud mode

### E-commerce Application

React and TypeScript e-commerce storefront project with API service integration.

- Repository: https://github.com/mdmoin7/ecom-app
- Technologies: React, TypeScript, Vite
- Focus: typed frontend architecture and API-backed storefront development
